map.选择齿轮类型（直齿/斜齿/锥齿），输入对应参数计算几何尺寸: Select the gear type (spur/helical/bevel) and enter the corresponding parameters to compute the geometry
map.直齿圆柱齿轮：标准齿轮，齿顶高系数 ha*=1，顶隙系数 c*=0.25: Spur cylindrical gear: standard gear, addendum coefficient ha*=1, clearance coefficient c*=0.25
map.斜齿圆柱齿轮：螺旋角 β 一般取 8°~20°，过小轴向力小但平稳性差，过大轴向: Helical cylindrical gear: the helix angle β is usually 8°-20°; too small gives a low axial force but poor smoothness, too large gives a high axial force
map.直齿锥齿轮：以大端模数为标准，节锥角由齿数比决定: Straight bevel gear: the large-end module is the standard, and the pitch cone angle is determined by the tooth ratio
map.锥齿轮齿宽 b 一般取锥距 R 的 1/3: The bevel gear face width b is usually taken as 1/3 of the cone distance R
map.📚 深度解析：锥齿轮/斜齿轮几何: 📚 In-Depth Analysis: Bevel / Helical Gear Geometry
map.直齿/斜齿/锥齿轮的几何参数计算。: Geometry parameter calculation for spur, helical and bevel gears.
map.锥齿轮锥距 R、平均模数 mm 与齿宽 b 确定。: Determination of the bevel gear cone distance R, mean module mm and face width b.
map.斜齿轮端面模数 mt、螺旋角 β 下的尺寸。: Helical gear dimensions with the transverse module mt and helix angle β.
Normal module mn=2, helix angle β=15°: transverse module mt=mn/cosβ=2/0.9659≈2.07 mm; d=mt·z.
map.锥距 R 的作用？: What is the role of the cone distance R?
map.锥距是分度圆锥母线长，决定齿轮大小与齿宽上限（b 一般 ≤R/3），影响接触强度: The cone distance is the slant length of the pitch cone; it determines the gear size and the upper limit of the face width (b is usually ≤R/3) and affects the contact strength.
map.平均模数为何小于大端模数？: Why is the mean module smaller than the large-end module?
map.锥齿轮沿齿宽模数从小端到大端递增，平均模数用于强度校核的代表值。: For a bevel gear the module increases along the face width from the small end to the large end; the mean module is the representative value used for strength checking.
map.齿轮类型计算器，支持直齿圆柱齿轮、斜齿圆柱齿轮、直齿锥齿轮三种类型，根据各自参数: A gear type calculator supporting spur cylindrical, helical cylindrical and straight bevel gears; according to each type's parameter characteristics it computes the pitch circle, addendum circle, dedendum circle, equivalent number of teeth, cone distance and other geometry.
